# healthchecksio_pause (Action)

Pauses a check. A paused check sends no alerts. It stays paused until its next ping, or until a resume when `manual_resume` is true. Needs a read-write API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "healthchecksio_pause" "maintenance" {
  config {
    check_id = healthchecksio_check.backup.id
  }
}

# To start the action from the CLI: terraform apply -invoke=action.healthchecksio_pause.maintenance
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `check_id` (String) The check: its unique_key (the `id` of `healthchecksio_check`) or its UUID.
